name: Femi Palmer
headline: 3x Founder

sections.bio:
With over six years of professional experience, I specialize in guiding startups through strategic growth, leveraging my expertise in corporate partnership development, GTM strategies, and operational optimization. Currently, as an Operating Partner at Initio Capital, I work closely with founders to align products with market needs, develop effective sales strategies, and support team building initiatives. My goal is to empower innovative ventures to scale sustainably while fostering a culture of collaboration and impact.  

At Initio Capital, I have partnered with entrepreneurs to refine their fundraising strategies, implement actionable growth plans, and streamline operations. My background in co-founding an AI-powered career platform and driving business development in early-stage startups equips me with a unique perspective on navigating challenges and creating value. By aligning solutions with market demands, I aim to empower teams to achieve their full potential and drive meaningful results.
